## FLOOWBOX - GitHub Trending Analyzer
Runs daily at 8 AM.
GitHub Search API: top 20 repos in AI/automation topics.
Perplexity: context on what is gaining traction this week.
GPT-4o: extract patterns, learning ops, n8n integration ideas.
Daily Slack brief + saves to Notion.

Great for staying current on what developers are building.
